get.description:
The tenant's audit trail, newest first. Append-only — there is no
write, update, or delete path anywhere.

post.description:
Revoke the presented credential server-side and clear cookies.

Bearer → the token's jti joins the revocation registry until expiry.
Session cookie → the durable session row is revoked.

Exchange the live session cookie for a fresh short-lived Bearer token.

Throttled like login. The CSRF middleware has already enforced the
Origin/Referer allowlist for this mutating, cookie-authenticated request.
Human-only close (R6): outcome + resolution summary mandatory.

Validate + store one document, then run extraction inline.

Identical bytes re-uploaded within the org return 200 with the existing
document (per-org content dedup) — deduplicated=true.

delete.description:
Hard delete (org_admin only — destructive; docs/DATABASE.md §1: no soft
delete). Refused with 409 while the document is referenced by a purchase
order, an invoice, or a bank account's R5 verification record. The stored
object is deleted through the StorageProvider seam; extraction results,
fields and the document's own processing jobs go with it.

patch.description:
Human field review (R3): confirm or correct one extracted field.

Only ``reviewer``/``org_admin`` (docs/API.md §5 role matrix — the same
roles that verify bank accounts). ``confirm`` marks the extracted value
human-verified; ``correct`` requires a non-empty ``verified_value`` and
preserves the original extraction untouched. Both stamp verified_by/at
and write an audit event.

get.description:
Protected download: org-scoped 404 first, then the stored bytes with
the recorded content type.

post.description: Idempotent retry: enqueue (or re-enqueue) the extraction job.

Human disposition of one signal ("Work cases" row of docs/API.md §5:
org_admin / finance_officer / reviewer; audited).

A non-empty reason is MANDATORY and the override is recorded as a
review_actions row (on the given case, the invoice's latest case, or
case-less). A disposition is an annotation — it never rewrites severity,
the assessment, or the invoice status (the §8 forcing rules are not a
disposition away), and the original automated assessment is preserved
immutably.

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

post.description:
Create an invoice. Duplicate vendor+number is allowed — it becomes an
evidence match + needs_review (a fraud signal, never a 409).

EVC assessment (Evidence-based Vendor Consistency): an explainable
0-100 consistency score over six features, each carrying an uncertainty
state (verified_agreement / confirmed_discrepancy / insufficient_evidence).

Persists the full structure in ``fraud_assessments.evc`` (features,
weights, contributions, policy_version) + per-signal findings; review_required
and high_risk_discrepancy force ``needs_review`` (machine-set, audited);
critical assessments auto-open a case (R6). Never claims genuineness (R2).

schema.title: Response Latest Assessment Api V1 Invoices  Invoice Id  Assessment Get

post.description:
Human review decision on one evidence match ("Work cases" row of
docs/API.md §5: org_admin / finance_officer / reviewer; audited). This is
the disposition path the duplicate_candidate finding points at via its
``evidence_refs``. A non-empty reason is MANDATORY and the decision is
recorded as a review_actions row; the underlying detection evidence is
never altered.

get.description: One job of the caller's organization; cross-org ids are 404.

Headline counts for the caller's organization only.

Read-only decision support: these numbers never assert that any invoice
is genuine (R2) — ``needs_review_invoices``/``high_risk_invoices`` are
work-queue sizes, not verdicts.

Masked account list. reviewer/org_admin additionally receive the R5
verification provenance (the investigation view); other roles do not.

post.description:
Register a bank account — ALWAYS born ``pending`` (R5).

The raw account number exists only in this request body: the service
fingerprints it, stores the hash + last4, and the value never lands in
the database, the audit log, or any response.
Human approval (R5): method + reference/document + verifier mandatory.

Reviewer decision (R5): on approval the service creates the already-
approved account stamped with the deciding human.
